description:
s36 and s48, DEFERRED ON PURPOSE. Do not freeze exact graph/table controls yet. Agreed contract only: select source region -> automatic extraction/digitisation -> source shown ALONGSIDE extracted data -> human correction/review -> Accept -> Markdown + fenced TOML + CSV/math. The original selected source must remain visible during review.

The digitiser ENGINE is KEEP, not rewrite: src/digitiser/{calibration,dataset,trace,detect,auto,raster,synthetic,table_ocr,frontend}.rs, ~3,300 lines with existing tests. What changes is its PLACEMENT -- s25 demotes it from a top-level tab to a contextual tool launched from the Research workspace. Preserve the mandatory-human-review invariant: the CLI can only ever emit Unreviewed, only a human marks a dataset reviewed, and editing a point resets it. Preserve the structural provenance requirement: a DigitisedDataset cannot be constructed without a FigureSource and a PlotCalibration.

REUSE for the artifact-append path: save_into_project (op-96am) already appends a digitiser CSV with page/pixel/date/author provenance into a named section of a project markdown, driven by CropProvenance. Adapt it for s19/s20's fenced-TOML+CSV output rather than writing fresh.
